newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish KPW clears Warta's new share issue.
newsitem.headline: Polish KPW clears Warta's new share issue.

text.p: Poland's Securities Commission (KPW) on Tuesday approved for public trade a new share issue of Towarzystwo Ubezpieczen i Reasekuracji Warta SA, destined for three banks and two shareholders, Warta's president said.
"The KPW today approved our new issue, which is earmarked for our two current shareholders and three banks," Andrzej Witkowski told a news conference.
He said the issue price was 48 zlotys. The subscription will begin on February 5 and close on February 28. @
The issue of between 865,380 and 2,596,139 shares is earmarked for Bank Przemyslowo-Handlowy SA (BPH), Kredyt Bank SA, Powszechny Bank Kredytowy SA, Kluczyk Holding SA and Anna Wozniak.
"Our talks suggest that the whole issue would be subscribed," Witkowski said.
He said about 75 percent of earnings from the issue would be used for acquisition of shares of banks from the treasury while the rest to develop its distribution network and infrastructure.
